title: Decide bounded replay for qualified readiness I/O refusals of prepared reports
outcome: Resolve how prepared observation delivery handles qualified readiness store_open_refused with kind io, with an explicit policy that reflects recoverable and permanent producer failures.
acceptance: Establish which producer I/O failures may recover and record the delivery policy for those and permanent failures.
The host and documentation implement the agreed policy while retaining the exact original request and readable redacted terminal diagnostics. Deterministic cases cover the selected behavior.
